## Result

::: {#thm-analytic-extension name="Analytic extension"}
Text before math

$$
\sum_{i=1}^{\infty} \frac{1}{i^{-1}} = - \frac{1}{12}.
$$

Text after math
:::

The result of @thm-analytic-extension is super cool and not at all misunderstood

::: {#thm-line name="Line"}
The equation of any straight line, called a linear equation, has the form:

$$
y = mx + b
$$

where $m$ is the slope and $b$ is the y-intercept.
:::

This is the standard form of @thm-line.
